recipe.name: Viscum / investment / Gold 18k
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Factory 003 Clover at native 18 x 18, lost wax, sprued at the palm. The bough, its leaves and its nodes are cast with the ring. After the pour: drill each berry seat on its raised mark, cut it to the measured moonstone and burnish flush. Polish the leaves and the bough; leave the lobes' ground as cast and pumiced.
